description: This file defines equality operators for Rectangle and Fraction structures within the firebolt::rialto namespace, used for comparison purposes in the project.

methods.name: operator== (const Rectangle &lhs, const Rectangle &rhs)
methods.description: Checks if two Rectangle objects are equal based on their x, y, width, and height properties.

methods.name: operator== (const Fraction &lhs, const Fraction &rhs)
methods.description: Checks if two Fraction objects are equal based on their numerator and denominator.
